ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels in the interior lobes and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edges and central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches occupy the central and inner portions of both lobes. A continuous black band follows the trailing edge and widens toward the median notch. Small white high-intensity spots are scattered across the black regions of the peduncle and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:4 relative to the inner fluke boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge of the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge exhibits coarser, higher-amplitude peaks near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a pronounced concave curvature originating from the median notch and terminating at acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels (barnacle scars) localized on the distal tips and along the low-intensity trailing edge boundary of both lobes; additional scattered white dots on the central black peduncle area.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, low-intensity (black) sub-circular spot is visible within the high-intensity (white) field of the right lobe, located in the lower-central quadrant relative to the lobe tip.
